name: The Egyptian Museum
description: A major museum in Cairo with extensive collections including royal statues, papyri, sarcophagi, jewelry, and objects connected to ancient Egyptian history.
opening_hours: 09:00 AM-05:00 PM daily; ticket window closes 04:00 PM

name: National Museum of Egyptian Civilization (NMEC)
description: A national museum presenting Egyptian civilization across different periods and housing major collections, including the Royal Mummies Gallery.
opening_hours: 09:00 AM-05:00 PM daily; evening hours 06:00 PM-09:00 PM; ticket window closes 04:00 PM for daytime

name: The Coptic Museum
description: A museum of Coptic heritage containing manuscripts, icons, carved woodwork, frescoes, and material recovered from monasteries and churches.
opening_hours: 09:00 AM-05:00 PM daily; ticket window closes 04:00 PM

name: Museum of Islamic Art
description: A Cairo museum with a large collection of Islamic artifacts covering subjects such as astronomy, medicine, architecture, woodwork, ceramics, and manuscripts.
opening_hours: 09:00 AM-05:00 PM daily; ticket window closes 04:00 PM

name: Giza Pyramids / Great Pyramid
description: The Giza pyramid complex includes the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the last surviving Wonder of the Ancient World, together with other monuments on the Giza Plateau.
opening_hours: 07:00 AM-05:00 PM daily; midday closure indicated on the official page

name: Saqqara
description: A large ancient cemetery area containing monuments from multiple periods, including the Step Pyramid complex and the Imhotep Museum.

name: Dahshur
description: An ancient pyramid field associated with Sneferu and the development of pyramid construction, including the Bent Pyramid and Red Pyramid.

name: Serapeum at Saqqara
description: An underground funerary complex at Saqqara associated with the sacred Apis bulls and the cult of Ptah.

name: Karnak Temple
description: A vast temple complex in Luxor featuring the Great Hypostyle Hall, monumental columns, obelisks, sanctuaries, and the sacred lake.

name: Luxor Temple
description: A temple complex on Luxor's East Bank with major additions by Amenhotep III and Ramesses II and a prominent Great Colonnade.

name: Valley of the Kings
description: The New Kingdom royal burial ground on Luxor's west bank, containing more than sixty tombs and additional unfinished tombs.

name: Hatshepsut Temple
description: A mortuary temple on Luxor's west bank with terraces, painted reliefs, and scenes including Hatshepsut's expedition to Punt.

name: Mummification Museum
description: A museum explaining ancient Egyptian mummification through tools, objects, canopic jars, coffins, mummified remains, amulets, and religious material.
opening_hours: 09:00 AM-02:00 PM daily; evening hours 05:00 PM-09:00 PM

name: Deir al-Bahari
description: A west-bank archaeological area containing royal mortuary temples, including the temple of Hatshepsut.

name: Nubia Museum
description: A museum dedicated to Nubian culture and history, with exhibition galleries, a garden, prehistoric rock inscriptions, and a reconstructed Nubian house.
opening_hours: 09:00 AM-05:00 PM daily; evening hours Thursday-Friday 06:00 PM-09:00 PM

name: Philae Temple
description: A temple complex associated with Isis whose monuments were relocated to Agilkia Island during the UNESCO Nubia Campaign to protect them from flooding.

name: Abu Simbel
description: A monumental rock-cut temple complex built by Ramesses II, famous for its colossal statues and the relocation of the temples during the Nubia rescue campaign.

name: Kom Ombo Temple
description: A Graeco-Roman temple dedicated to Sobek and Horus the Elder, notable for its symmetrical design and reliefs including medical imagery.

name: Edfu Temple
description: A well-preserved ancient Egyptian temple dedicated to Horus, constructed during the Ptolemaic period and known for its monumental pylons and halls.

name: Crocodile Museum
description: A museum at Kom Ombo displaying mummified crocodiles and material connected with the local cult of Sobek.
opening_hours: 07:00 AM-09:00 PM daily; ticket office closes 08:00 PM
